'''Red Four''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of the fourth member of Red Squadron. There were a number of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] with this name, and several [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] went by the call sign Red Four.

==History==
===Galactic Republic===
A [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] using the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] participated in the [[Battle of Rendili]], flying to the aid of "[[Blue Five/Legends|Blue Five]]," a fellow pilot surrounded by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|vulture droids]].<ref name="R70" />

A [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7 ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor]] pilot flew as "Red Four" with the Republic's [[Red Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Red Squadron]] under [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mavra Zane]] in [[Rebellion on Felucia|pursuit]] of Separatist leader [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]], and in [[Trihexalon attack on Coruscant|defense]] of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] over [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where the pilot was shot down by an enemy [[Belbullab-22 starfighter/Legends|heavy starfighter]].<ref name="Kinect" />

===Rebel Alliance===
Prior to the destruction of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]], [[Cesi Eirriss]] flew a [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]] as Red Four for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]]. After she was [[Mission to Commenor (0 BBY)|killed]] over [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor]],<ref name="XWRS.5">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron ½|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' ½]]</ref> [[John D. Branon/Legends|John D. Branon]] became her replacement and flew during the pivotal [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in which he lost his life.<ref name="ANH" />

A pilot under the command of [[Red Leader/Legends|Red Leader]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] was assigned the call sign during a [[Reconnaissance mission to Kamino|mission]] to [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].<ref name="RF:F">''[[Rebel Force: Firefight]]''</ref>

After the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace Azzameen]] flew an [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wing interceptor]] under the call sign Red Four while investigating an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Comm Center|communications array]] to discover the identity of the Alliance's [[Zaletta|anonymous informant]].<ref name="XWA">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]''</ref>

[[Derek Klivian/Legends|Derek Klivian]] was assigned this call sign in the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|attack]] on the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]].<ref name="Death Star II Limited">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Red Squadron 4}}</ref> During the battle, his X-wing was struck by enemy fire and lost power, spinning out of control.<ref name="ROTJ">[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|''Star Wars'' Episode VI: ''Return of the Jedi'' novelization]]</ref>

Shortly after the Alliance's victory at [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], a pilot using the call sign Red Four flew with the Rebel [[Bakura task force]] during the [[Bakura/Legends|planet's]] [[Invasion of Bakura|invasion]] by the [[Ssi-ruuvi Imperium]]. "Red Four" was part of an element of Red Squadron tasked with maintaining an escape cone for [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue]] and [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gold Squadrons]].<ref name="TAB">''[[The Truce at Bakura]]''</ref>

===New Republic===
Derek Klivian again flew as Red Four under [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]]' [[Red Flight]] on a mission to the planet [[Adumar/Legends|Adumar]].<ref name="XW:SoA">''[[X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar]]''</ref>

[[Jojo]] flew as Red Four during the [[Battle of Doornik-319]].<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
